segments.name: Life Science
segments.description: Develops and markets instruments, systems, reagents, and consumables for biological research and biopharmaceutical applications.
segments.evidence: Our Life Science segment develops, manufactures, and markets instruments, systems, reagents, and consumables used to separate, purify, characterize, and quantify biological materials, including cells, proteins, and nucleic acids.

segments.name: Clinical Diagnostics
segments.description: Designs and manufactures diagnostic test systems and informatics solutions for clinical laboratories in the global diagnostics market.
segments.evidence: Our Clinical Diagnostics segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supports diagnostic test systems, informatics solutions, test kits, and specialized quality controls for clinical laboratories in the global diagnostics market.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase instruments, reagents, and consumables; Clinical Diagnostics generates recurring revenue from ongoing sales of test kits and consumables.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue in this business is largely recurring, as laboratories generally standardize on specific testing platforms that rely on a supplier's instruments, reagents, and consumables. As a result, an installed base of diagnostic systems typically generates recurring revenue through ongoing sales of test kits and consumables for each sample processed.
